definition.prompt: Design one square sticker sheet containing exactly sixteen separate stickers in a clean 4-by-4 grid. Use the uploaded character as the sole character, keeping the face, hairstyle, outfit and colors consistent. Give each cell a different everyday emotion or gesture: joy, surprise, thanks, encouragement, sleepiness, celebration, curiosity, agreement, apology, determination, greeting, laughter, relief, confusion, excitement and affection. Simple expressive cartoon drawing, white cutout borders, generous separation. Add one short Chinese caption per cell from this supplied list: 开心; 哇; 谢谢; 加油; 困了; 庆祝; 好奇; 好的; 抱歉; 坚持; 你好; 哈哈; 松口气; 疑惑; 激动; 抱抱. Avoid background scenes and overlapping stickers. Render every caption verbatim, in reading order, without shortening or omitting any Chinese character. In particular, retain all three characters in 松口气 when that caption is supplied.

review.notes: The second attempt still shortens 松口气 to 松气. Retry with a shorter unambiguous caption while retaining sixteen emotions.
